rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for carrying out a duty conscientiously and responsibly.

example.english: We dutifully looked after the elderly.
example.traditional: 我哋一直盡責咁照顧啲長者。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 zik6 zeon6 zaak3 gam3 ziu3 gu3 di1 zoeng2 ze2

rows.note: Use this when the dutiful action especially involves obediently doing what one is told or expected to do.

example.english: The boss told us to hand in a report before we left, and we dutifully did it.
example.traditional: 老闆叫我哋收工前交份報告，我哋就乖乖咁做。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 dei6 sau1 gung1 cin4 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 dei6 zau6 gwaai1 gwaai1 gam3 zou6
